name: QiYi M Pro 3x3 V3 Pioneer (Magnetic, 20-Magnet Ball-Core, UV Coated) - SaoCube Edition
description: The QiYi M Pro 3x3 V3 Pioneer (Magnetic, 20-Magnet Ball-Core, UV Coated) is the fully-loaded version of QiYi's value flagship, pairing a 20-magnet ball-core with a glossy UV-coated finish and a visual dual-adjustment system borrowed from the flagship Tornado 3x3. It's a professional speedcubing feel engineered for cubers who want flagship behavior without the flagship price.
features: Grows with you: Beginner taking the next step or seasoned cuber prepping for competition, the wide tuning range lets one cube serve both.
8-level axis distance: Rotate the circular-hole position counterclockwise. The larger the number showing in the circular hole, the tighter the axis distance.
8-level elasticity: Rotate the triangular-indicator position clockwise. The larger the number on the triangular indicator, the stronger the elasticity.
UV diamond-coated finish: Wear-resistant, scratch-resistant, and brilliantly glossy, holding its premium look and refined texture through extended use.
Size: 55.5 x 55.5 x 55.5 mm, a mainstream speedcubing size built for a comfortable grip.
Weight: 70 g, light in hand for explosive speed.
